name: Seproxetine
summary: Seproxetine, also known as (S)-norfluoxetine, is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI). It is the (S) enantiomer of norfluoxetine, the active metabolite of the widely used antidepressant fluoxetine; it is nearly 4 times more selective for stimulating neurosteroid synthesis relative to serotonin reuptake inhibition than fluoxetine.

fact.en: Seproxetine is one mirror-image form of norfluoxetine, which the body makes from fluoxetine. It was studied as a drug in its own right but was not developed further.
